description: This source file provides parsing and conversion functions for interpreting numerical values, boolean values, and environment variables, primarily used in the context of Git configuration. It includes utility functions to parse signed and unsigned integers, doubles, booleans, and handling of unit suffixes such as 'k', 'm', 'g'.

methods.name: uintmax_t get_unit_factor(const char * end)
methods.description: Determines the numeric multiplier associated with a unit suffix ('k', 'm', 'g') in the input string, defaulting to 1 if no suffix matches.

methods.name: int git_parse_signed(const char * value,intmax_t * ret,intmax_t max)
methods.description: Parses a string as a signed integer with optional unit suffixes, considering maximum bounds.

methods.name: int git_parse_unsigned(const char * value,uintmax_t * ret,uintmax_t max)
methods.description: Parses a string as an unsigned integer with optional unit suffixes, ensuring it does not overflow the maximum.

methods.name: int git_parse_int(const char * value,int * ret)
methods.description: Parses a string as an int, utilizing git_parse_signed.

methods.name: int git_parse_int64(const char * value,int64_t * ret)
methods.description: Parses a string as an int64_t, utilizing git_parse_signed.

methods.name: int git_parse_ulong(const char * value,unsigned long * ret)
methods.description: Parses a string as an unsigned long, utilizing git_parse_unsigned.

methods.name: int git_parse_ssize_t(const char * value,ssize_t * ret)
methods.description: Parses a string as ssize_t, utilizing git_parse_signed.

methods.name: int git_parse_double(const char * value,double * ret)
methods.description: Parses a string as a double, optionally applying a unit suffix factor.

methods.name: int git_parse_maybe_bool_text(const char * value)
methods.description: Interprets a string as a boolean text, recognizing common true/false representations.

methods.name: int git_parse_maybe_bool(const char * value)
methods.description: Interprets a string as a boolean, first as text, then as an integer.

methods.name: int git_env_bool(const char * k,int def)
methods.description: Reads an environment variable and interprets it as a boolean value, using a default if missing.

methods.name: unsigned long git_env_ulong(const char * k,unsigned long val)
methods.description: Reads an environment variable as an unsigned long, with error handling.

ctags.name: git_env_ulong
ctags.pattern: /^unsigned long git_env_ulong(const char *k, unsigned long val)$/
